name: AppUi::Box
description: An AdminLTE box with square edges: header, tools, body and footer blocks.

variant.description: primary, default, info, success, warning or danger

listView.description: Adds the list-view class for list pages

noPadding.description: Removes the padding of the box body

header.description: The header content, usually a box-title

tools.description: Icon buttons on the right of the header

top.description: Unwrapped content between the header and the body, e.g. a list toolbar

bottom.description: Unwrapped content between the body and the footer, e.g. pagination
